Summing along a longest saturated chain gives the sharp upper bound. The canonical depth vector attains every required normalized halfspace margin, proving the lower bound and the full center description. Prefix/suffix depth bounds prove the uniqueness criterion. All quantifiers include every nonempty finite poset; height counts elements. A finite exhaustive checker through six elements corroborates but is not used as proof.
